learning_outcomes.text: Students are able to describe cyclic processes and analyze them regarding process variables work and heat exchange, thus making statements about the efficiency of cyclic processes.
Students master the application of fundamental energy conversion methods and the thermodynamic evaluation of thermal power plants.

syllabus_topics: Power plant processes: Clausius-Rankine process, Joule process
Components of coal and gas power plants: combustion chamber, boiler, turbine, condenser, cooling, flue gas cleaning
assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded upon successful completion of the module exam. The form of the exam (written or oral) will be announced at the beginning of the course.
